VB.Net Systems Analyst/Developer 
 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a VB.Net Systems Analyst/Developer for a contract opportunity in New York, NY.
 VB.Net Systems Analyst/DeveloperJob Details 
 The developer is responsible for the system analysis, detail design, development, implementation and maintenance of the in-house applications. The successful candidate should have strong coding/unit testing skill, communication skills, a user-service orientation, familiarity with the team decision-making process and excellent problem-solving abilities. Financial Industry experience is a plus. Bilingual Japanese/English is a plus.
 VB.Net Systems Analyst/Developer Mandatory Skills 
 At least 5 years of experience programming in VB.Net Framework and SQL
 Proven experience writing system documentation (system design, detail design, test plans, test execution, implementation plans and implementation execution)
 Experience working through full SDLC cycle, from system requirements and design specifications through implementation Strong analytical and problem solving skills
 Ability to create and manage unit test project is a plus
 Ability to troubleshoot applications and identify root cause of defect
 Excellent written and verbal communication
 Domain knowledge of Financial/Banking Institution methodologies is a plus
 Knowledge of tools: Visual Studio, TFS, SQL management studio, Microsoft Office, SVN Programming language: VB.Net (.Net Framework) OS: Windows 7 RDBMS: SQL Server
 Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
 VB.Net Systems Analyst/Developer Start Date 
 ASAP
 VB.Net Systems Analyst/Developer Assignment Length 
 12+ months


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
